decisive_items: Total occlusion at the ostium of the left anterior descending coronary artery
Deeply inverted T-waves in leads V2 to V4
response.rationale: The LAD occlusion plus deep anterior T-wave inversions and abnormal Q-waves best support an anterior myocardial infarction pattern. Normal troponin makes acute MI less certain, but the fixed LAD occlusion and ECG changes are more specific than vasospasm or hypertension alone.

rejected.why: Exertional pain relieved by rest and pseudonormalizing T-waves without ST elevation are not characteristic of variant angina.
Hypertension and elevated blood pressure are risk factors, but they do not explain the LAD occlusion, Q-waves, or ischemic T-wave changes.
